title: My dad loved LOVED this movie and this character. We had leg lamps up...
transcript: Okay, one more take. They call you Lady Luck, but there is room for doubt. At times you have a very unladylike way. Evening is over. You might give me the brush. You might forget your manners. You might refuse to say, luck, be a lady tonight. Luck, be a lady tonight. Luck, if you've ever been a lady to begin with. Luck, be a lady tonight.
classificationReason: The transcript is a personal singing/cover video of 'Luck Be a Lady' (from Guys and Dolls), referencing a movie character and a leg lamp. Guys and Dolls is not on the list, and there is no review of any stage production — just a song performance with a personal anecdote.
